defs.def: a person who is unable to stop taking harmful drugs 吸毒成瘾的人；瘾君子

ex.s: So, if you're a sugar addict and aren't able to say no to chocolate or cola, you had better download it now!
ex.t: 所以，如果你是一个糖瘾者，不能对巧克力或可乐说不，你最好现在下载！

ex.s: So, ever since I discovered selfie apps that could remove my freckles, enlarge my eyes and even slim my jawline, I have become addicted.
ex.t: 因此，自从我发现可以去除雀斑、放大眼睛甚至缩短下巴线的自拍应用程序以来，我已经上瘾了。

ex.s: Some students even become addicted to the Internet and cannot concentrate on school and family life.
ex.t: 有些学生甚至沉迷于互联网，无法专注于学校和家庭生活。

ex.s: Since then, she has been addicted to the Internet, using different kinds of software applications on her mobile 1.
ex.t: 从那时起，她就沉迷于互联网，在手机上使用不同类型的软件应用程序1。

defs.def: a person who is very interested in sth and spends a lot of their free time on it 对 … 入迷的人

ex.s: Collocations (2) make addicted to get stuck a lot of harm be cars protect in a traffic jam op up sb pick theenvironment cause excuses share global warming Manypeopleoften1 when they go to work.
ex.t: 搭配（ 2 ）使上瘾者陷入困境的很多伤害是汽车在交通堵塞中受到保护，导致环境变暖的借口很多人在上班时经常分享全球变暖的借口。
